findings.title: Contractual penalty not specified as sole remedy
findings.deviation: Delay penalties are capped at 5% of the milestone fee and exclude client-caused delay, but the penalty is credited against actual delay damages rather than agreed as the sole remedy.
findings.impact: Client could seek damages for delay exceeding the penalty amount, subject to crediting the penalty already paid.
findings.quote: The contractual penalty shall be credited against any claim for damages for the same delay.
findings.counterPosition: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; no LDs where the delay is caused by the client; LDs are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

fine.note: Liability is capped at total contract remuneration with carve-outs aligned with governing statutory requirements.
Indemnification is mutual, restricted to third-party claims resulting from culpable acts, with notice and defence controls.
AtliQ retains ownership of PipeKit while granting a non-exclusive licence, and client ownership of deliverables vests only upon payment.
Acceptance includes a 10-day review period, deemed acceptance on silence, and protection against rejection for minor defects.
Convenience termination provides compensation for services rendered and committed costs, and good cause requires 30 days notice to cure.
DPA under Art. 28 GDPR and EU SCCs for data transfers to India are incorporated as Annex 3.
No non-compete, non-solicit, or exclusivity covenants are imposed.
No insurance coverage limits or certificate requirements are imposed.
12-month warranty from acceptance conforming to specifications with standard remedy mechanisms.
Payment is due without deduction and no set-off mechanism against other agreements is included.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with standard carve-outs and a fixed five-year post-termination term.
Payment terms are 30 days without pay-when-paid provisions.
